description: This is a Java source file defining the class TileView, which extends Android's View class. It manages a grid of drawable tiles for rendering, including loading bitmaps for tiles, setting individual tiles, and drawing them on a canvas. It appears to be part of an Android application, specifically for a snake game, given the package name and context.

classes.name: TileView
classes.description: A custom Android View used for managing and rendering a grid of tiles or icons, suitable for games or similar applications. It provides methods to load tile images, reset tiles, set individual tiles, and handle size changes.

methods.name: TileView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TileView with attribute set, extracting tile size from styled attributes.

methods.name: clearTiles
methods.description: Resets all tiles in the grid to 0, representing empty.

methods.name: loadTile
methods.description: Loads a drawable into the tile array at a specified key by converting it into a bitmap.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overridden method to draw all non-zero tiles in the grid onto the canvas.

methods.name: resetTiles
methods.description: Initializes the tile array with a given size to hold bitmap images for tiles.

methods.name: setTile
methods.description: Sets a specific tile index at a given x,y position in the grid.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size changes to compute how many tiles fit horizontally and vertically, and initializes the grid accordingly.
